commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP: install podman"
sudo -n dnf install -y podman >/tmp/dnf-install.log 2>&1 || (tail -50 /tmp/dnf-install.log; exit 1)
podman --version

echo "STEP: create appsvc user"
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appsvc
id appsvc

echo "STEP: enable subuid/subgid (usually auto via useradd, verify)"
grep appsvc /etc/subuid /etc/subgid

echo "STEP: enable lingering for appsvc (allows user services without active login session)"
sudo -n loginctl enable-linger appsvc
loginctl show-user appsvc -p Linger

echo "STEP: prepare systemd user dir for appsvc"
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user
sudo -n chown -R appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/.config

echo "STEP: write rootless podman quadlet-free systemd user unit for web container on 8080"
sudo -n tee /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Rootless web app container
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/podman rm -f webapp
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run --rm --name webapp -p 8080:80 docker.io/library/httpd:alpine
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman stop -t 10 webapp
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
sudo -n chown appsvc:appsvc /home/appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service

echo "STEP: enable systemd linger runtime dir and start service as appsvc via its own user bus"
sudo -n machinectl shell appsvc@ /bin/bash -c '
set -Eeuo pipefail
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u)
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now webapp.service
sleep 3
systemctl --user status webapp.service --no-pager || true
' 2>&1 || true

echo "STEP: verify via loginctl / systemctl (should work without active login)"
sleep 5
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u appsvc) systemctl --user status webapp.service --no-pager || true

echo "STEP: check no login session for appsvc"
loginctl list-sessions | grep appsvc || echo "no active session for appsvc (expected)"

echo "STEP: verify port 8080 listening"
ss -tlnp | grep 8080 || true

echo "STEP: curl the service"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/ || true

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: confirm user manager running due to linger"
sudo -n systemctl status user@1000.service --no-pager | head -20

echo "STEP: enable+start webapp via appsvc's own user bus (no machinectl, no login session)"

sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus systemctl --user enable --now webapp.service

echo "STEP: wait for container pull+start"

echo "STEP: confirm no active login session for appsvc"

echo "STEP: verify port and http"

curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/ || true

echo "STEP: wait for user manager + service to settle after boot"
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
